result.title: A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts
result.summary: Aging is characterized by continuously evolving health states, yet most existing prediction models focus on static health risk at isolated time points rather than explicitly modelling how health trajectories unfold over time. We developed a health world model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to represent evolving health states and simulate future trajectories under specified actions. The model combines a state encoder, an action- and context-conditioned predictor, a stop-gradient target encoder, and clinical outcome heads. We trained the model on the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and evaluated it without refitting in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Open-loop evaluation assessed discrimination and calibration for mortality and worsening of activities of daily living (ADL) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADL). In the held-out HRS test set, the areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) for mortality, ADL worsening, and IADL worsening were 0.89, 0.93, and 0.93 at the first horizon and 0.84, 0.84, and 0.85 at the fifth horizon, respectively. Predicted risks stratified subsequent outcomes across horizons. Across the evaluated horizons, mortality AUROC ranged from 0.867 to 0.881 in ELSA and from 0.796 to 0.801 in CHARLS. Simulated trajectories preserved the expected risk ordering across predefined action regimes. In counterfactual simulations, changes in lifestyle actions shifted predicted risks in directions consistent with observed associations. The model provides a framework for longitudinal risk prediction and action-conditioned simulation in older adults.

AI.brief_summary: 该文基于 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture 构建「健康世界模型」，用状态编码器、动作与上下文条件化的预测器及带 stop-gradient 的目标编码器在潜空间中刻画老年人健康状态的演化，并在多国队列上做纵向风险预测与反事实轨迹模拟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其潜空间状态预测、动作条件化状态更新与 stop-gradient 目标监督，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新方式和轨迹监督提供架构线索，但领域为健康队列数据且无视觉输入，需核查其表示是否保留任务必要细节。
